note: OpenAPI schema fidelity fixes: a garde pattern is documented only when every escape is valid in ECMA-262 u mode (allowlist: escaped punctuation such as \- or \# outside a class, a lone ], and Rust-only property names such as \p{Greek} skip it); a flattened newtype / transparent wrapper or recursive generic instance of a deny_unknown_fields struct is merged, and a flattened closed enum is inlined without additionalProperties false, so neither rejects the outer struct's keys; a flattened Box<Option<T>> is optional; an optional field with aliases accepts at most one of its names; a unit variant with a variant-level with / serialize_with / deserialize_with is documented as a newtype variant on that side; an externally tagged serde(other) payload of an internally tagged newtype lists the tag in its map form (also for an all-unit enum) and every payload branch allows exactly one key besides the tag, while a flattened enum no longer documents the serde(other) map form; expand_return_type_alias reports false when a self-recursive alias leaves the type unchanged.
